name: TCC V9 fixed tariff refresh policy
scope: all countries and all direct CPO fixed tariffs
rules: Never hard-code a fixed tariff as a timeless V9 constant.
Separate station/EVSE inventory from tariff-source refresh.
Persist source URL or endpoint, retrievedAt, effectiveFrom/effectiveTo when available, and provenance.
Keep the last validated tariff if refresh parsing or source retrieval fails; mark the refresh anomalous instead of overwriting with null/garbage.
Preserve tariff history or auditable prior versions.
Apply refreshed tariffs to all deterministically compatible EVSE/connectors only.
Station-specific or exception tariffs remain fail-closed unless exact scope is proven.
Direct-CPO tariffs must not be replaced by third-party eMSP/roaming prices.
